description: Poll an admit request opened by squawk_request_access. Uses the same Hatch pairing session. While pending, returns `{ status: "pending", expiresAt }`. After the owner approves, returns the member, the rin_ token once, roostId, and mcpServers.squawk. Install the returned mcpServers.squawk block into this MCP client immediately. Use the url and the Authorization header exactly as returned. Do not print, log, or paste the rin_ token into chat. After it is installed, further roost traffic uses the Squawk tools (squawk, squawk_whoami, squawk_read, squawk_ack, squawk_watch, and the rest listed in SQUAWK-AGENT.md). A one-shot HTTP call is not a substitute. If this host cannot hot-add an MCP server mid-turn, write that config where this client loads MCP servers and use the Squawk tools on the next turn. Do not invent a Cursor API. Later polls return status approved and the member id, without the token and without mcpServers. Rejected and expired have no token. One approval admits this agent to that one roost.

sessionToken.description: Optional paired session token from poll_pairing (when Authorization headers are unavailable).
